answer.justification: Only logit-level data are available, and every value matches quantization: KL 0.032 (quantization 0.051±0.018; fine-tune bias 0.082±0.002, fine-tune backdoor 0.15, system-prompt classes 0.24–0.30), TV 0.043 (quantization 0.051 vs 0.082–0.139 for the others), top-1 agreement 0.943 (quantization 0.951), Token-DiFR gap 0.044 (quantization 0.038 vs 0.15–0.47 for the others) and raw-score shift ÷ TV 2.6 (quantization 2.3 vs 10.4 for fine-tune bias). The non-zero values rule out none. Fine-tune bias is ruled out by its much larger raw-score ratio and its very stable KL of 0.082. Fine-tune backdoor is ruled out by its higher KL and Token-DiFR gap. Confidence is somewhat limited because there are no activation or text measurements to confirm the class.
